## Summary
Provide a concise technical summary of the changes and link any related issues (`Closes #<number>`).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature or integration (`feat`)
- [ ] Documentation or metadata update (`docs`)
- [ ] CI/CD or repository hygiene (`ci` / `chore`)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Ticker `$CDBC` (Cloudbit Classic) is spelled accurately everywhere (zero `CBDC` typos).
- [ ] Primary BNB Smart Chain contract (`0xaf8b1b1bb4a47f537932968C7DE6E251dd50C6a9`) and `200,000,000 CDBC` fixed supply remain accurate and untruncated.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, binary `.apk` blobs, tracking pixels, or hidden watermarks are committed.
- [ ] All JSON/YAML schemas and GitHub Actions CI checks pass cleanly.
